scope_reminder: Two replacement Google guides only. No transfer was in scope and none was submitted.

exact_copy_diagnostic.result: word exact, with no declared allowance needed

02.reading: A large improvement, not a truncation. The ending decays from 0.1452 to 0.0087 RMS in its final 100 ms and the full script reads back word exact. The pinned tail gate measures a 60 ms window and sees 0.0224 against a 0.02 threshold, so it fails by 0.0024. This is the EP007 marginal case, where the precedent is explicit: do not transfer a marginal guide without listening to its ending.

03.cost_note: No duration was returned so no cost was recorded and none is counted against the cap. A 502 is an upstream failure rather than a rejected request, so whether Google billed it cannot be established from the response; the conservative reading is that the aggregate estimate may understate by at most one call.
03.reading: Nothing was produced. 03 still has no usable guide at any revision.

policy_result: The no-retry authorization stopped after each outcome. The aggregate Google call cap of six is now reached, so neither a third attempt at 02 nor a first usable guide for 03 can be made without fresh owner authority.
preserved: narration-v1 is untouched and was set read-only for this run. Its four guides, receipts and raw responses remain as immutable evidence and the aggregate counters read them.
open_decisions: whether 02's marginal ending is acceptable, which is a listening call
whether 04's dual-model corroboration is acceptable, still open from the previous hold
03 has no audio and needs one call

options_for_the_owner.option: Listen to 02's new ending, then authorize one Google call for 03.
options_for_the_owner.note: The narrow path. If 02's ending sounds clean, the only missing piece is 03, and a 502 is a transient server error worth one more attempt.

options_for_the_owner.option: Authorize one call for 03 and accept 02 and 04 on the evidence, then transfer all four.
options_for_the_owner.note: Fewest round trips to finished narration. Accepting 02 overrides the tail gate by 0.0024 and accepting 04 rests on the two-model corroboration; both would be recorded as deliberate overrides.

options_for_the_owner.option: Authorize one call for 03 plus a third attempt at 02.
options_for_the_owner.note: Only worth it if 02's ending is audibly short. Two attempts have now landed at 0.2408 and 0.0224, so a third may still not clear 0.02.

options_for_the_owner.option: Raise or re-examine the 0.02 tail threshold.
options_for_the_owner.note: Three of six guides in this episode have failed it, and 02's second attempt is word exact with a decaying tail. The threshold is pinned in calibrate.py and is a method-level choice, not an EP009 one. Changing it is out of scope here and would need its own decision.

limitations: Local ASR cannot prove an unclipped final phoneme and does not replace owner listening. The word-exact read on 02 establishes that no word is missing; it does not establish that the final consonant is fully released. Nothing here speaks to voice match, performance or register, which are judgments on Original C audio that does not yet exist.
